title: CGX-Native Universal Printer Identity and Handshake
authority_boundary: candidate Frontier semantic object; does not mutate Cognigrex.cgx or durable domain child carriers

semantic_model.rule: printer identity is a federated child/node identity, not a replacement master

compute_layers.name: deterministic machine control
compute_layers.constraint: must remain locally executable and safety-bounded without network access

compute_layers.name: local CGX node runtime
compute_layers.note: does not require smartphone-class dense compute if the task/control stack is distributed and compiled

compute_layers.name: Cognigrex / LightSpeed federation
compute_layers.rule: bind to live runtime; do not duplicate authoritative network state into every printer

handshake: HELLO: identity + hardware/software revision + authority pointers
TASK_OFFER: required function, geometry, evidence tier and delivery constraints
PLAN_RECEIPT: compiled BuildNode DAG + source hashes + accepted limits
EXEC_RECEIPT: deterministic execution trace + raw evidence locators
VERIFY: measured function + uncertainty + residual/falsifier state
HANDOFF: child/sibling node state transfer when work migrates
physical_identity_options: RFID/NFC or printed antenna identity where suitable
cryptographic secure-element/root candidate when security class requires it
material/process passport linked to logical CGX identity

smartphone_equivalence_boundary.statement: Functional equivalence is separated from semiconductor-density equivalence.
smartphone_equivalence_boundary.example: A phone-like object may provide display, storage, sensing, communications, control and UI using larger/distributed printed functions plus modest edge compute and CGX network services.
smartphone_equivalence_boundary.constraint: Claims of iPhone-class local compute, size, efficiency or semiconductor density require corresponding semiconductor hardware evidence and are not implied by the UTP architecture.
